ordering_evidence: This protocol commit must descend from the sealed v241.1 implementation commit and precede every v242 formal or independent result. Git ancestry, source closure, exclusive output directories, and the sealed parent inventory are authoritative; the timestamp is descriptive only.
scope: Post-open deterministic solver gate on the already opened BLASTNet hydrogen-air Case 7 sequence. It tests the actual unchanged K14 PCGLS coefficients after the frozen pre-update FIFO16 initializer and four equal-or-cheaper classical solver controls. It is not a learned predictor, prospective external result, wall/RSS measurement, curved-ray result, or real-BOST result.
scientific_question: Does the actual frozen FIFO16 warm initializer followed by fourteen unchanged geometry-Jacobi PCGLS iterations satisfy every K16-matched field, full-gradient, interior-gradient, and observation gate on all 533 later Case 7 cells and all 13 complete rigs, and is that success unexplained by any equal-or-cheaper zero-start or normalized-backprojection solver control?
physical_hypothesis: v241 showed that the pre-update FIFO16 plus current K1-through-K14 span contains enough metric-specific directions. The falsifiable next question is whether the recurrence coefficients already produced by unchanged PCGLS select a jointly valid field without truth-aware coefficient fitting.

sealed_v241_parent.root_role: private v241 formal, first independent, and sealed-array erratum tree outside Git

sealed_data_and_physics.upstream_contract: Reuse without change every v235, v237, v240, and v241 input, source, preprocessing, operator, reported geometry, observation, truth, K16 reference, geometry-Jacobi preconditioner, cache canonicalization, metric, gate, and tolerance bound by the sealed parent protocols.
sealed_data_and_physics.dataset: the same already opened public BLASTNet hydrogen-air Case 7 density sequence
sealed_data_and_physics.reference: the independently validated v235 zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 fields and metrics
sealed_data_and_physics.truth_use: only offline scoring after every field, residual, exact-call ledger, and causal cache update has been generated and sealed; never initialization, solver coefficients, preconditioner, cache update, control selection, fallback, or stopping

unique_primary.name: dynamic_preupdate_fifo16_actual_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k14
unique_primary.frame_zero: zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16, identical to the frozen reference and v237 cache anchor
unique_primary.later_frames: Form x0=U(Q^T y) from the exact frozen pre-update FIFO16 cache, run fourteen unchanged geometry-Jacobi PCGLS iterations from x0, and score the actual K14 field and residual returned by the recurrence. After scoring, update the FIFO cache with the first current PCGLS direction only, exactly as v237-v241; never update with the K14 field.
unique_primary.deployment_inputs: current and prior observations plus reported geometry only

equal_or_cheaper_controls.name: zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k14
equal_or_cheaper_controls.rule: zero-start unchanged geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K14 independently on each later frame

equal_or_cheaper_controls.name: zero_unpreconditioned_cgls_k14
equal_or_cheaper_controls.rule: zero-start unchanged unpreconditioned CGLS K14 independently on each later frame

equal_or_cheaper_controls.name: normalized_bp_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k13
equal_or_cheaper_controls.rule: Use one exact A-transpose and one exact A to form the observation-only normalized backprojection alpha A-transpose y with alpha=||A-transpose y||^2/||A A-transpose y||^2, reuse its exact projection, then run thirteen unchanged geometry-Jacobi PCGLS iterations

equal_or_cheaper_controls.name: normalized_bp_unpreconditioned_cgls_k13
equal_or_cheaper_controls.rule: Use the same exactly accounted normalized backprojection and cached projection, then run thirteen unchanged unpreconditioned CGLS iterations

arms.common_frame_zero_rule: Every arm uses the same zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 frame-zero field, residual, metrics, and 16A+16A-transpose ledger. This isolates later-frame warm-start behavior and makes all complete-rig tails comparable.
arms.control_roster_boundary: These four controls cover Zero, BP, CGLS, and PCGLS under a componentwise equal-or-lower exact-call budget. No Case 7 dual-ridge or neural artifact is fitted after opening this condition; historical dual-ridge evidence is not relabeled as a v242 control.
forbidden_variants: any primary depth other than K14
using a metric-specific v241 oracle coefficient vector
changing the FIFO cache rank, reset, update, or coefficient rule
reusing the K14 field as a cache update
K15 or any control exceeding 15A or 14A-transpose on a later frame
changing the preconditioner, normalized-BP formula, solver stopping, tolerance, or regularization
post-result arm addition, threshold tuning, selector fitting, fallback, CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, or GPU rescue

accuracy_contract.arm_pass_rule: All 546 frame cells must pass all four absolute and matched cell limits, and every one of 13 complete rigs must pass all four absolute and matched p90-higher and worst limits.
accuracy_contract.primary_required: The unique primary must pass the arm rule. A truth-aware v241 lower bound is not a substitute for the actual K14 field.
accuracy_contract.control_dominance: Any frozen control that passes the same complete arm rule and has both sequence A and A-transpose counts no greater than the primary blocks a warm-specific advantage claim. No scalar score or average metric can override this rule.

cost_accounting.logical_ledger_boundary: Counts include only arm construction. They exclude offline truth scoring, formal consistency replay, independent validation, permutation auditing, and geometry-Jacobi setup.
cost_accounting.geometry_jacobi_setup: offline setup, separately disclosed and unchanged

validity_and_independence.independent_implementation: The validator must not import the formal v242 runner or the v237/v241 recycling numerical cores. It independently implements FIFO modified Gram-Schmidt, geometry-Jacobi PCGLS, unpreconditioned CGLS, normalized backprojection, metrics, tails, dominance, call ledgers, permutation replay, and final decision from the sealed v235 data and v241 provenance.

decision_order: Any parent, source, data, operator, adjoint, cache, finite-array, residual-replay, exact-call, permutation, v241-lower-bound, or independent-recomputation failure makes v242 INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE7_ACTUAL_K14_SOLVER_CONTROLS_V242.
If the K16 reference adequacy inherited from v235 is not preserved, conclude INCONCLUSIVE_INADEQUATE_CASE7_K16_REFERENCE_V242.

If the unique actual-K14 warm primary fails any frozen cell or complete-rig gate, conclude FAIL_CASE7_ACTUAL_K14_WARM_SOLVER_V242 and close the current actual-K14 FIFO16 mechanism without predictor or larger-model rescue.

If the unique primary passes but one or more equal-or-cheaper controls pass, conclude PASS_CASE7_K14_CALL_HEADROOM_BUT_WARM_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V242 and report every dominating control. This establishes deterministic strict-call headroom on the opened Case 7 condition but blocks a warm-specific or learned-advantage claim.

Only if the unique primary passes and every frozen equal-or-cheaper control fails may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE7_ACTUAL_K14_WARM_SPECIFIC_HEADROOM_V242. This establishes deterministic current-condition call headroom, not wall/RSS, external generalization, learning, curved rays, real BOST, paper success, or an algorithm breakthrough.
